messages:
Priya (Design): Quick sync on autoscale controls mock. Key goals: 1) SLO slider should clearly show Off / Preset / Custom states, 2) Burst needs to be discoverable on dense pool rows, 3) keyboard focus must follow pool picker -> burst -> slo. Loom attached with screens. Noah (Frontend): Got it. Two constraints to note: moving Burst out of the card increases vertical height; keyboard order mirrors DOM so we'll need to reorder elements if we want linear tabbing. I can try a right-anchored compact Burst toggle. Ava (A11Y): +1 for linear keyboard flow. A11y nits: burst pill contrast is ~3.8:1, needs 4.5:1; SLO slider must announce mode via aria-valuetext (eg "SLO 200ms, preset"); preset buttons should use aria-pressed. Also please ensure visible focus rings. Sam (PM): Defaults must be conservative to avoid cost spikes. Set default min/max to a safe range. Add inline guardrail: when burst >50% show small hint about cost/latency tradeoffs. If SLO exceeds pool capacity show a soft nudge (do not auto-upgrade). Jae (Eng): Implementation notes: burst maps to `burst_quota` on the API and is scoped to pool_id. If we move the UI element, ensure we still bind to selected pool. Suggest backend expose presets as `preset_id` so we don't keep migrating slider values. Also enforce burst_quota <= pool_max with an inline warning. Priya (Design): Draft microcopy: change label to "Burst capacity" and tooltip: "Temporary extra GPUs for spikes — billed while active." SLO visual states: Off = ghosted thumb + "Disabled" label; Preset = filled track + chip with preset name; Custom = filled track + numeric readout. I'll update FigJam. Noah (Frontend): For aria I'll add role="slider" plus aria-valuemin/max/now and aria-valuetext for screen readers. Example:
. Also will ensure DOM order matches tab order. Ava (A11Y): That example is good. Make sure the burst toggle gets focus in one tab press from the pool picker. Avoid visual-only rearrangement that doesn't match DOM. Sam (PM): Copy choice for capacity nudge: option A "This SLO may need more capacity — view options" or B "SLO exceeds pool capacity — explore upgrade." I prefer A, less alarming. Priya (Design): A it is. I'll include the phrasing and the guardrail hint in the updated mocks. Also adding an a11y checklist: contrast, aria-values, focus order. Noah (Frontend): I'll prototype the compact burst toggle and revised DOM order tomorrow, wire cost-estimator to show an estimated monthly delta when SLO changes, and ship behind a feature flag to staging. deploy-bot: deploy/ui-staging v2.21.0 succeeded — https://staging.redwood.dev/deploys/4378 Priya (Design): Thanks team — ping me when staging is live and I'll run a quick keyboard/usability pass. :rocket:
